description: This file defines the HandlerList class within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class manages a chain of middleware functions and a handler to process AWS commands, including adding/removing middleware, ordering, and resolving the middleware stack into a single callable. It supports different steps such as init, validate, build, sign, and attempt, allowing flexible customization of request handling.

classes.name: HandlerList
classes.description: Manages a list of middleware functions and a handler to process AWS SDK commands.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HandlerList with an optional HTTP handler.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of all middleware functions and handler in the list.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the main HTTP handler that returns the response.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if the handler list has a handler assigned.

methods.name: appendInit
methods.description: Adds middleware to the init step at the end.

methods.name: prependInit
methods.description: Adds middleware to the init step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendValidate
methods.description: Adds middleware to the validate step at the end.

methods.name: prependValidate
methods.description: Adds middleware to the validate step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendBuild
methods.description: Adds middleware to the build step at the end.

methods.name: prependBuild
methods.description: Adds middleware to the build step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendSign
methods.description: Adds middleware to the sign step at the end.

methods.name: prependSign
methods.description: Adds middleware to the sign step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendAttempt
methods.description: Adds middleware to the attempt step at the end.

methods.name: prependAttempt
methods.description: Adds middleware to the attempt step at the beginning.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts middleware before a specific existing middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts middleware after a specific existing middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes middleware by name or by instance.

methods.name: interpose
methods.description: Sets or removes an interpose function to wrap middleware for additional processing or tracing.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Combines all middleware and the handler into a single callable for execution.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of middleware functions across all steps.
